notes: Historical two-year INCOME-STATEMENT example only, transcribed from company investor presentations. This is not a complete five-year company dataset, a current financial update, or a DCF valuation. Balance-sheet and cash-flow inputs are deliberately absent. Operating EBIT excludes other income and joint-venture results. EBITDA is reconstructed consistently as operating EBIT plus depreciation; it may differ from a presentation headline. Source amounts are INR million, not crore (divide by 10 to convert to crore).
